category_title: Students with severe intellectual disability (SID) using pre-symbolic or limited symbolic communication and idiosyncratic repair strategies
minimal_context: The student is participating in a daily classroom routine and is asked to transition to the table.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: It is time for our daily routine. Please sit at the table.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Makes eye contact and points to a toy) want.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: No, you cannot have the toy right now.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Frowns, uses a different gesture, and points to a graphic symbol on the board instead) no.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: We are not doing that either. Just sit down.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: (Turns completely away from the tutor to look at another staff member across the room, dropping hands and stopping all communication attempts.)

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: It is time for our daily routine. Please sit at the table.

STUDENT: (Makes eye contact and points to a toy) want.

TUTOR: No, you cannot have the toy right now.

STUDENT: (Frowns, uses a different gesture, and points to a graphic symbol on the board instead) no.

TUTOR: We are not doing that either. Just sit down.

STUDENT: (Turns completely away from the tutor to look at another staff member across the room, dropping hands and stopping all communication attempts.)
